# Programs of MLton's regression suite that tests/external/run-mlton.sh
# skips, an expectation to a line in the one format (docs/testing.md,
# Expectations): `* | NAME | UNSUPPORTED | KIND: reason`, of the kinds below.
#   EXTENSION   needs an extension of MLton or SML/NJ (MLton.*, SMLofNJ.*, a
#               WordN or IntN of a width the specification does not have)
#   DEFINITION  MLton accepts or types the program where the Definition
#               rejects it or leaves the choice to the implementation
#   WIDTH       assumes MLton's 32-bit int or word, or its size limits
#   READING     MLton reads the specification otherwise (or departs from it)
#   HARNESS     needs files, a program name or merged output that the runner
#               does not provide
#   SLOW        does not finish in the runner's 20 seconds on the interpreter
#   SCOPE       needs a part of the Basis Library that Rune leaves out
#   LIMIT       exceeds a compiler resource budget (docs/language.md)
# Remove a line when its program passes.
* | abstype | UNSUPPORTED | DEFINITION: MLton treats abstype as a datatype; the Definition forbids equality on the type outside the body (rule 19)
* | args-create | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Process
* | args-spawn | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Process
* | binio | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (passes in about 100 s)
* | callcc | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Cont
* | callcc2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.Cont.callcc
* | callcc3 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton
* | cmdline | UNSUPPORTED | HARNESS: prints CommandLine.name, which MLton's run gives as ./cmdline
* | command-line | UNSUPPORTED | HARNESS: prints CommandLine.name, which MLton's run gives as ./command-line
* | conv | UNSUPPORTED | WIDTH: assumes a 32-bit int, MLton's default; Rune's has 64 bits
* | conversion | UNSUPPORTED | DEFINITION: MLton types the word constants of x8 from a later declaration (as Word8.word); Rune resolves overloading at the end of each top-level declaration (Appendix E allows it) and defaults them to word
* | date-localOffset | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.ProcEnv.setenv
* | eq | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.eq
* | exn-history | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.exnHistory
* | exn-history3 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.exnHistory
* | exponential | UNSUPPORTED | LIMIT: f applied 32 times has a type of 2^32 nodes once unshared; type translation exceeds --type-work (docs/plans/type-checker.md)
* | fast | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter
* | filesys | UNSUPPORTED | HARNESS: needs the file README and the links testlink, testcycl and testbadl where it runs
* | finalize | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
* | finalize.2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
* | finalize.3 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
* | finalize.4 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
* | finalize.5 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
* | finalize.6 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Finalizable
* | fixed-integer | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: Int2 ... Int64, widths the specification does not have
* | flat-array.4 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: Word14, a width the specification does not have
* | gc-collect | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.GC.collect
* | gc-collect2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.GC.collect
* | general | UNSUPPORTED | WIDTH: expects Array.array (Array.maxLen + 1, ()) to overflow (MLton's maxLen is maxInt); Rune's maxLen is 100000000, so it raises Size
* | harmonic | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
* | int-inf.2 | UNSUPPORTED | WIDTH: assumes a 32-bit int, MLton's default; Rune's has 64 bits
* | int-inf.5 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
* | int-inf.compare | UNSUPPORTED | DEFINITION: MLton types an integer constant from a later declaration; Rune resolves overloading at the end of each top-level declaration (Appendix E allows it) and defaults the constant to int
* | int-inf.rep1 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
* | int-inf.rep2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
* | int-inf.rep3 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
* | int-inf.rep4 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
* | int-inf.rep5 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.IntInf
* | int-overflow | UNSUPPORTED | WIDTH: expects Int.fromString to overflow at 32 bits; Rune's int has 64
* | kitsimple | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter
* | mlton.overload | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton's _overload declaration
* | mlton.share | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.share
* | mlton.word | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Word
* | mutex | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
* | nextAfter | UNSUPPORTED | READING: nextAfter (r, t) returns r when r = t, as the specification says, so nextAfter (~0.0, 0.0) is ~0.0; MLton returns t, as C's nextafter does (docs/basis-compat.md)
* | once | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: SMLofNJ.Cont
* | pack | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.GC
* | prodcons | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
* | real | UNSUPPORTED | READING: MLton prints ~0.0 without its sign under SCI, FIX and GEN (docs/basis-compat.md), fuses Real64 *+, makes a numeral with a huge exponent INF in IEEEReal.fromString, and computes Real32.rem inexactly (rem (maxFinite, 1230.0) is 0.2E32, not below 1230)
* | real-int | UNSUPPORTED | WIDTH: converts ints from Int.minInt on, which has 32 bits in MLton; Rune's int has 64
* | real-str | UNSUPPORTED | READING: Real.fromDecimal rounds in the current rounding mode; MLton rounds to nearest in every mode
* | rlimit | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Rlimit
* | same-fringe | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Thread
* | serialize | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton
* | signals | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
* | signals2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Thread
* | signals3 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
* | signals4 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
* | size | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.size
* | slow | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
* | slow2 | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
* | slower | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (passes in about 8 minutes)
* | smith-normal-form | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (IntInf; not done after 10 minutes)
* | socket | UNSUPPORTED | DEFINITION: MLton resolves undetermined top-level types across declarations (the mode of a socket); the Definition rejects them (rules 87-89)
* | string | UNSUPPORTED | READING: MLton expects String.fromCString to give SOME "" where no character converts; the specification says NONE
* | string.fromString | UNSUPPORTED | READING: String.fromString converts an unescaped double quote, the reading of SML/NJ and Poly/ML (docs/basis-compat.md); MLton stops at it
* | suspend | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Signal
* | test-create | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Process
* | test-spawn | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Process
* | textio | UNSUPPORTED | HARNESS: the expected output is stdOut and stdErr merged; the runner compares stdOut
* | textio.2 | UNSUPPORTED | SLOW: too slow on the interpreter (passes in about 100 s)
* | thread-switch | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton
* | thread-switch-share | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Thread.Runnable.t
* | thread-switch-size | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Thread.Runnable.t
* | thread0 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Thread
* | thread1 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton
* | thread2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton
* | timeout | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton
* | undetermined | UNSUPPORTED | DEFINITION: MLton resolves undetermined top-level types across declarations; the Definition rejects them (rules 87-89)
* | weak | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Weak
* | weak.2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.Weak
* | weak.3 | UNSUPPORTED | DEFINITION: val cache = ref [] gets its type from a later declaration, which MLton allows and the Definition rejects (rules 87-89); the program also needs MLton.Weak
* | weird-word1 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: Word5, a width the specification does not have
* | weird-word2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: Word5, a width the specification does not have
* | widechar | UNSUPPORTED | READING: test42 wants WideChar.fromCString to read C's hexadecimal escape of 0x67AB as U+67AB; Rune's reads one up to 255 only (the note on WideChar, lib/basis/widechar.sml), and passes the rest; its escapes of eight hexadecimal digits need --unicode (docs/plans/utf8.md, D7), which the runner does not pass
* | word | UNSUPPORTED | WIDTH: assumes a 32-bit word, MLton's default; Rune's has 64 bits
* | word-all | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: Word2 ... Word31, widths the specification does not have
* | wordn-array | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: Word5, a width the specification does not have
* | world1 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.World
* | world2 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.World
* | world3 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.World
* | world4 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.World
* | world5 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.World
* | world6 | UNSUPPORTED | EXTENSION: MLton.World
